ama_string: Collins GS, Moons KGM, Dhiman P, et al. TRIPOD+AI statement: updated guidance for reporting clinical prediction models that use regression or machine learning methods. BMJ. 2024;385:e078378. doi:10.1136/bmj-2023-078378
claim_it_supports: Reporting standard (27-item TRIPOD+AI checklist, supersedes TRIPOD 2015) for studies using regression or ML.

ama_string: Riley RD, Snell KI, Ensor J, et al. Minimum sample size for developing a multivariable prediction model: PART II - binary and time-to-event outcomes. Stat Med. 2019;38(7):1276-1296. doi:10.1002/sim.7992
claim_it_supports: Minimum n and events for model development by shrinkage >=0.9, R2 difference <=0.05, precise overall risk; rules of thumb (e.g., 10 EPP) inadequate. Supports the sample-size check, not a specific number for this cohort.

ama_string: Riley RD, Snell KIE, Archer L, et al. Evaluation of clinical prediction models (part 3): calculating the sample size required for an external validation study. BMJ. 2024;384:e074821. doi:10.1136/bmj-2023-074821
claim_it_supports: Sample size for external validation studies should be tailored to the model and setting, not rules of thumb.

ama_string: Christodoulou E, Ma J, Collins GS, et al. A systematic review shows no performance benefit of machine learning over logistic regression for clinical prediction models. J Clin Epidemiol. 2019;110:12-22. doi:10.1016/j.jclinepi.2019.02.004
claim_it_supports: 71 studies; logit(AUC) difference 0.00 (95% CI -0.18 to 0.18) in 145 low-risk-of-bias comparisons, 0.34 favoring ML in 137 high-risk comparisons; calibration unaddressed in 79%.

ama_string: van der Ploeg T, Austin PC, Steyerberg EW. Modern modelling techniques are data hungry: a simulation study for predicting dichotomous endpoints. BMC Med Res Methodol. 2014;14:137. doi:10.1186/1471-2288-14-137
claim_it_supports: Logistic regression reached stable AUC at about 20-50 events per variable; RF, SVM, NN remained optimistic beyond 200 EPV. Supports caution with flexible models and few events.

ama_string: Manoharan SR, Baker DK, Pasara SM, et al. Thirty-day readmissions following adult spinal deformity surgery: an analysis of the National Surgical Quality Improvement Program (NSQIP) database. Spine J. 2016;16(7):862-866. doi:10.1016/j.spinee.2016.03.014
claim_it_supports: NSQIP 2011-2013, 7 CPT codes, n=747, 30-day readmission 7.5% (56/747). Supports published NSQIP ASD readmission rate and cohort-definition precedent.
checked_against: Abstract; authors verified from PubMed record

ama_string: Lucas DJ, Haut ER, Hechenbleikner EM, et al. Avoiding immortal time bias in the American College of Surgeons National Surgical Quality Improvement Program readmission measure. JAMA Surg. 2014;149(8):875-877. doi:10.1001/jamasurg.2014.115
claim_it_supports: Immortal time bias in NSQIP readmission (30 days from surgery, not discharge). No abstract in PubMed (research letter); claim taken from title and the background file, NOT confirmed against the text.

ama_string: Loria A, Melucci AD, Burchard PR, et al. Implementation of a new definition for acute kidney injury in the National Surgical Quality Improvement Project: What is the impact? Surgery. 2023;174(1):2-9. doi:10.1016/j.surg.2022.11.035
claim_it_supports: NSQIP AKI definition changed 1 July 2021; single-institution AKI rate 0.3% pre vs 5.6% post (OR 26.2). Supports not pooling renal outcomes across the definition change.

ama_string: Buckland AJ, Poorman G, Freitag R, et al. National Administrative Databases in Adult Spinal Deformity Surgery: A Cautionary Tale. Spine (Phila Pa 1976). 2017;42(16):1248-1254. doi:10.1097/BRS.0000000000002064
claim_it_supports: Deformity billing codes in NSQIP rose 68x (2006-2013) while physician-managed ASD stayed stable; NSQIP cases less invasive (fewer levels, fewer 3-column osteotomies). Supports cohort-definition caveat.

ama_string: Poorman GW, Passias PG, Buckland AJ, et al. Comparative Analysis of Perioperative Outcomes Using Nationally Derived Hospital Discharge Data Relative to a Prospective Multicenter Surgical Database of Adult Spinal Deformity Surgery. Spine (Phila Pa 1976). 2017;42(15):1165-1171. doi:10.1097/BRS.0000000000002002
claim_it_supports: After matching, overall complication rate 24.31% NSQIP vs 68.24% surgeon-run ASD database. Supports under-capture of complications in NSQIP.

ama_string: Van Calster B, McLernon DJ, van Smeden M, et al. Calibration: the Achilles heel of predictive analytics. BMC Med. 2019;17(1):230. doi:10.1186/s12916-019-1466-7
claim_it_supports: Calibration should be assessed for regression and ML models; calibration curves need sufficiently large samples; balance model complexity with sample size.

ama_string: Vickers AJ, Elkin EB. Decision curve analysis: a novel method for evaluating prediction models. Med Decis Making. 2006;26(6):565-574. doi:10.1177/0272989X06295361
claim_it_supports: Original description of decision curve analysis (net benefit across threshold probabilities). Supports use of net benefit; does not itself address ML.

ama_string: van den Goorbergh R, van Smeden M, Timmerman D, et al. The harm of class imbalance corrections for risk prediction models: illustration and simulation using logistic regression. J Am Med Inform Assoc. 2022;29(9):1525-1534. doi:10.1093/jamia/ocac093
claim_it_supports: Undersampling, oversampling, SMOTE gave poorly calibrated models (risk overestimated) with no AUC gain. Supports not resampling for rare outcomes. Study used logistic regression, not tree ensembles.

ama_string: Gallagher DO, Bondar K, Hirase T, et al. Risk Factors for and Prediction of Early Thromboembolic Disease Following Adult Spinal Deformity Surgery: An Analysis of >7,400 Patients with Spinal Deformity. J Bone Joint Surg Am. 2025;107(11):1219-1226. doi:10.2106/JBJS.23.01391
claim_it_supports: NSQIP 2010-2019, CPT 22843/22844 (>=7 levels posterior instrumentation), n=7,445; VTE 3.4%. Supports the long-segment instrumentation cohort definition and cohort size precedent.

ama_string: Dunias ZS, Van Calster B, Timmerman D, et al. A comparison of hyperparameter tuning procedures for clinical prediction models: A simulation study. Stat Med. 2024;43(6):1119-1134. doi:10.1002/sim.9932
claim_it_supports: One-standard-error rule for CV tuning often gave severe miscalibration; standard 5/10-fold CV (repeated or not) performed well; bootstrap slightly worse calibration. Supports tuning by CV minimum, not 1-SE.

ama_string: Zhang AS, Veeramani A, Quinn MS, et al. Machine Learning Prediction of Length of Stay in Adult Spinal Deformity Patients Undergoing Posterior Spine Fusion Surgery. J Clin Med. 2021;10(18):4074. doi:10.3390/jcm10184074
claim_it_supports: NSQIP posterior ASD fusion, n=1,281, prolonged LOS >=9 days, LR/tree/RF/XGBoost/GB, AUC 0.566-0.821. Precedent for ML in NSQIP ASD and the >=9-day LOS threshold.
